utterances.text: I can just say something very tentative. I would need a broader context. This is the northern side of Stradun. Yes.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Stopped at 3.20. What street is that?

utterances.speaker: SLOBODAN VUKOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Siroka Street viewed from Stradun towards the south.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: What can you see in the bottom left hand on the pavement of that shot behind or underneath the red taping?

utterances.speaker: SLOBODAN VUKOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Well, the same material I referred to earlier on. That is to say, roof tiles that were totally smashed up. And also, little pieces of stone material.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Where the cursor is, at the immediate bottom right-hand corner, there's a post which -- can you see any shrapnel or any damage to that particular object?

utterances.speaker: SLOBODAN VUKOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, yes. There are parts of shrapnel that can be seen.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Just go back to 3.30, there's a shot which shows a hole in the pavement on Stradun. I just want you to tell the Trial Chamber where that particular -- where this particular shot is taken from. That's at 3.27. Stop.

utterances.speaker: SLOBODAN VUKOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Could you please replay this footage so I can see it again. This was recorded from the beginning of Siroka Street towards the northern side of Stradun. This is the building that is next door to the festival building. We can go on now if you wanted me to comment on other matters.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: I'm just interested in the hole in the pavement which was shown at about 3.27. Was that similar to the other holes in the pavement you've commented on earlier?

utterances.speaker: SLOBODAN VUKOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Could you show me the hole, please, and then perhaps I can describe it in greater detail.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: What can you say about the impact and the marks to the right? There's two people standing there. One in white who I assume is an ECMM monitor. And to the right, there were two other legs. What can you say about the hole, its dimensions, and the marks to the right of that? Those smaller marks on the pavement.

utterances.speaker: SLOBODAN VUKOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Well, this is a typical example, at least the way we interpreted it, of a mortar shell. According to the information we had, it had the effect of destroying the surface. This is a good example of how we perceived mortar-shell hits.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: All right. There's a large hole just between, really, the legs of the person in white, and there are some smaller marks between his legs and the legs of the person wearing beige trousers. What can you say about those smaller holes, the smaller marks coming away from the larger hole?

utterances.speaker: SLOBODAN VUKOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: If you mean the one down here, that is to say, by the legs of the person wearing beige trousers --

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: SLOBODAN VUKOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: -- that is exactly what I was talking about. The effects of an explosion of a mortar shell. That was at least our interpretation. And then we observed this. These small parts of the pavement that were broken, that is like when an ink drop falls on a piece of paper. So perhaps that would be a picturesque way of explaining what happened.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: And you mean radiating out from the point of impact. Is that another way of describing it, in one direction?

utterances.speaker: SLOBODAN VUKOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, yes. Radiating out from the centre towards the periphery, yes.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Which building are we looking now at 3.34?

utterances.speaker: SLOBODAN VUKOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Well, I've just said. It's the building right next door to the festival building, the one that also burned down. Just stop here now. And could you rewind it a bit. Stop. This is Mrs. Dragicevic. The Dragicevices were mentioned earlier on. This is Mrs. Berta Dragicevic, and she is actually my mother's neighbour in town. I just wish to draw your attention to this, if you permit me to do so.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Was she the one who had the keys to the Katic palace?

utterances.speaker: SLOBODAN VUKOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, yes.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: And that was at 3.45. Keep going. Just stop there. I've just stopped at 4. Which building is that?

utterances.speaker: SLOBODAN VUKOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: I think that this is the same building, but it's ground floor actually. Would you just rewind it a bit so that I can see the broader view in order to be able to confirm what I have been saying just now.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: When you say "same building," you mean the same opposite the festival palace that was burnt out?

utterances.speaker: SLOBODAN VUKOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: That's right.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: I just want to take you back to the building you just identified, again just stop there at 4.00. Just very briefly, the rubble which you can see on the footpath there to the right of the person with the camera, you described earlier red tiles. Is that the same sort of debris?

utterances.speaker: SLOBODAN VUKOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, yes.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: The building you've just seen from the inside of the -- the burnt-out building, 4.10 to 4.12, which building is that, do you know?

utterances.speaker: SLOBODAN VUKOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Well, I'd need to have a look at the outer side, if you can find one for me. I can only make an assumption now, but if you can find something like that for me, then I could confirm what building it really is.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: I'll stop you there at 4.16. There's a street, and there seems to be some smoke rising from somewhere. Do you know what street that is?

utterances.speaker: SLOBODAN VUKOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: I think this is a street going from Stradun towards Od Puca, and I think it belongs to block number 8. Now, which street is this? I think it could be the one right next to Siroka. I think it's called Cubranoviceva or something like that.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Stop there at 5. Is that a shot of the Onofrije fountain at 5.01?

utterances.speaker: SLOBODAN VUKOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes. We see part of the fountain.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Stop there. At 5.13, there's a shot of the stairs which encircle the fountain. Just atop the red tape that is surrounding, do you see any damage there?

utterances.speaker: SLOBODAN VUKOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, we can see that part of the stone step was damaged. There's a part that's missing. And that's due to shrapnel, too.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: 5.17, what's that a shot of?

utterances.speaker: SLOBODAN VUKOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: These are the steps leading into the Franciscan church at the top of Stradun.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: What in your opinion has caused the damage shown in that still?

utterances.speaker: SLOBODAN VUKOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Correction. I'm sorry. Can you rewind it a bit so that I can have a broader view. These are the steps at the entrance into the Franciscan church at the stop of Stradun. So shrapnel damage can be seen here. That is to say, indirect damage.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Stop there. Time of 5.31, there's a shot of a building with some holes in the roof. Which building is that?

utterances.speaker: SLOBODAN VUKOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: This is the atrium of the Franciscan monastery, and this is one of the wings that comprise the cloister.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: 5.37, where is that one?

utterances.speaker: SLOBODAN VUKOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: It's the same building, and these are the columns of the atrium, and this is the top of the column that has been broken off the capital.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: At 5.55, there are some trees or palms which are broken to the ground. Whereabouts are those palm trees?

utterances.speaker: SLOBODAN VUKOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: It's in the same atrium.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: 6.05, where is that?

utterances.speaker: SLOBODAN VUKOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: It's the same atrium, and it's the damaged balustrade on the terrace which is above the front entrance which goes all the way around the atrium.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: That's in the Franciscan monastery. What was the condition of those balustrades before the 6th of December?

utterances.speaker: SLOBODAN VUKOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: I don't know exactly. But I assume that it was whole. This is the result of the shelling of the 6th of December. This building is much too important for this not to be recorded already at this stage.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Just stop there. 6.54, we're still in the Franciscan monastery. Keep going. At 7.17 -- stop -- what does that show?

utterances.speaker: SLOBODAN VUKOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: This is the damaged inventory. I don't know exactly what that is. I don't know whether it's an exhibit or something but, in any case, it does belong to the Franciscan monastery.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Just stop there. At 7.32, there's a hole in the roof underneath. Is that Minceta to the right?

utterances.speaker: SLOBODAN VUKOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes. In the back, you can see the Minceta.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: The roof which was the concave-shaped hole in it just immediately to the left of -- below, to the left of Minceta, is that still the Franciscan monastery?

utterances.speaker: SLOBODAN VUKOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: That time was at 7.35.

utterances.speaker: SLOBODAN VUKOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: This is a building of the upper atrium of the monastery. It has two atriums. It has -- the one on the ground floor is a larger one, and there is another atrium which belongs to the upper part of the building.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: That was at -- time of 7.50. Just stop there. There's a person holding something at 8.18. What is it? Or do you recognise it?

utterances.speaker: SLOBODAN VUKOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes. These are the parts of the -- of a mortar shell, the wings of a mortar shell, 120-millimetre one.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: At 8.33, someone's holding something that looks like something coming from ammunition. Do you know what that is or have you seen something like that before?

utterances.speaker: SLOBODAN VUKOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: I assume that this is either a tank or a cannon shell, something like that. But I couldn't really say exactly.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Stop at 9.08. Do you know where that is? Can you recognise that?

utterances.speaker: SLOBODAN VUKOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: If you can just give me a broader frame, please. Yes. I think this was the interior of the old pharmacy, so this is an interior shot in the Franciscan monastery.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: And could you see any damage there?

utterances.speaker: SLOBODAN VUKOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Could you please just go back a little bit on the footage so that I can tell you a little bit more about it.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: We just showed you 9.07 to 9.12. Did you see any damage in those clips?

utterances.speaker: SLOBODAN VUKOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes. I saw traces of projectile impact and also a small part indicating shrapnel impact points. I think the previous -- the larger markings are from a direct hit.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Just stop there, at 10.13. Is that still in the Franciscan monastery?

utterances.speaker: SLOBODAN VUKOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: This is the famous library, the old library.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Just stop there. At 10.25, there's some debris on the floor of the library. What can you say about that debris relative to the debris that you saw in your inspections of buildings in the Old Town of Dubrovnik in December 1991?

utterances.speaker: SLOBODAN VUKOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: This example points to examples of direct hits which occurred above on the roof structure. So this probably came through the roof, which of course was also damaged in the same place. This is just an indication of a direct hit. That's one thing. Another thing is that this is definitely proof that this happened on the 6th of December and not before because, had it occurred before, it would have been removed by that time.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: What is it about the shape or dimensions or the consistency of the material that allows you to reach your conclusions?

utterances.speaker: SLOBODAN VUKOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: This is a fragment of straw which was -- had mortar over it. And it comes from the ceiling. So you can see a fragment of the ceiling, and you can also see the construction on which this mortar -- to which this mortar was attached. And you can see that from this example. That is the most important thing that leads us to conclude that this was actually a direct hit.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: 10.38, you can see a hole in the ceiling above. Can you comment on that?

utterances.speaker: SLOBODAN VUKOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: This is what I have just told you. There was probably a direct hit on the roof. It broke through the roof, and also through a part of the ceiling. So the place below the roof had also been damaged. And then you can see that as a result of the direct hit, that section of the ceiling fell.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Can you see daylight through that upside-down L-shaped hole in the ceiling between the cracks in the wood?

utterances.speaker: SLOBODAN VUKOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes. This little white blue part that you can see is actually a piece of sky that you can see.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Stop there at 11.22. It showed a building with a hole in the roof. Where is that building?

utterances.speaker: SLOBODAN VUKOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: This is the building where the Jadran restaurant was located at the time. We called it Klarisa. And it used to be St. Klarisa's monastery.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Is that immediately to your right as you come in the Pile gates behind the Onofrije fountain?

utterances.speaker: SLOBODAN VUKOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, that's that building.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: 11.25. There's a -- what looks like a fountain in the centre of the still. What's that?

utterances.speaker: SLOBODAN VUKOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: This is not a fountain. This is just the top part of a well, actually, that is below. And we can see the damage. The damage was caused by shrapnel. So it's an indirect hit.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Was that damaged on the 6th of December?

utterances.speaker: SLOBODAN VUKOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: 11.38, you can see some trees in the corner of a courtyard. Is that still the Jadran restaurant courtyard?

utterances.speaker: SLOBODAN VUKOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes. That's the atrium where the Jadran restaurant was.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: What can you say about the damage to the trees?

utterances.speaker: SLOBODAN VUKOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Nothing. It's fresh. You can tell by the green colour that it's fresh foliage and that this happened most probably on the 6th of December.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: 11.45, can you identify that building.

utterances.speaker: SLOBODAN VUKOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, it's the same building. Also this one.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: If you look at the shot which is 11.44.9, there's a pillar to the left and a window to the right. And the walls are a reddy [sic] ochre colour. There are some marks there. I think I can see six lighter coloured marks on that building. What are those marks?

utterances.speaker: SLOBODAN VUKOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: This was caused by shrapnel. This is a plaster facade that was painted, and the damage was obviously caused by shrapnel.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: We just saw a hole in paving at 11.50. You just described damage to the Jadran restaurant. Is that in the courtyard or is it somewhere else?

utterances.speaker: SLOBODAN VUKOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: I would need to see. Yes, yes, it's the same courtyard.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Is that impact similar to the ones you've described earlier on the Stradun?

utterances.speaker: SLOBODAN VUKOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Can you rewind it a little bit, and then I'll be able to tell you. Yes, it's similar. But the foundation here is earth. It's soil. And here, we're talking about fragments of stone. When they're hit by that kind of projectile, it leaves a small mark.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Stop. The building at 11.55, can you identify that building.

utterances.speaker: SLOBODAN VUKOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, it's the same building, or it's a complex of buildings comprising four wings. This is one wing that looks out to the west.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: And the damage that you can see above the window, the second window from the corner, in which direction is that facing, damage to the roof and gutter?

utterances.speaker: SLOBODAN VUKOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: This faces the east side.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Can you recognise the burnt-out building which is at 12.06 onwards?

utterances.speaker: SLOBODAN VUKOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: I think that this is the festival building filmed from the inside towards Stradun. And there is -- that's the side street there that we can see. Yes.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: The building which was just shown at 12.43, could you recognise where that one is?

utterances.speaker: SLOBODAN VUKOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: 13.43. Perhaps you can play that for me.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: 12.41, just there.

utterances.speaker: SLOBODAN VUKOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Could I look at a broader frame, please. I cannot identify it yet. It's a little bit dark, so I can't see it properly.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: It won't get any better. 12.44, 12.45, where's that?

utterances.speaker: SLOBODAN VUKOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes. This is the Iza Roka Street looking from the south to the north. This is a small street which is to the south of the Od Puca Street. And it leads to the St. Dominik church. This is the corner building towards Siroka Street.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: I just want you to comment on the rubble and debris you can see in the street at 12.45.

utterances.speaker: SLOBODAN VUKOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: This is rubble of the furniture, equipment, stone, crushed bricks that you can see. And this is what I saw when I went there for the first time. The street was strewn with rubble, and this is an example of what it looked like in one section.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Was St. Dominik church one that you inspected?

utterances.speaker: SLOBODAN VUKOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: No. St. Dominik's church is not shown here. There is St. Domino's church here. There is a difference because there is also a St. Dominik's monastery. But this is St. Domino's church.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: And I've just stopped at 12.56. There's a gentleman wearing a coat with black legs, and you can see in front of him the steps to the church. What can you say about the marks on the steps to the church?

utterances.speaker: SLOBODAN VUKOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Here, you can see well a place of direct impact. And you can see traces of the shrapnel which destroyed the staircase of the main entrance of St. Domino's church. I think this is an example of a mortar projectile. And I am concluding this on the basis of the surface effect that we can see here.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Are you referring to the -- what seems to be the area of damage behind the man with the black trousers? The cursor is just moving from right to left on the screen, at the bottom of the screen, at counter 12.58.

utterances.speaker: SLOBODAN VUKOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, I'm talking about that part, and also the part that is immediately in front of it. So this is a kind of cause and effect example of a direct hit and also the consequences of an indirect hit.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: You said you saw shrapnel. Can you point that out.

utterances.speaker: SLOBODAN VUKOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: No, I did not say that I saw shrapnel. I just said that I saw the traces of shrapnel.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Can you just clarify what you mean by "traces of shrapnel."

utterances.speaker: SLOBODAN VUKOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: The traces simply means the effects of impact by small shell fragments which disperse at the time of the impact of the shell, and they make these small holes or damage on the stone wall.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE PARKER
utterances.text: Is that a convenient time, Mr. Re?

utterances.speaker: MR. RE
utterances.text: It certainly is.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE PARKER
utterances.text: Yes, Mr. Re.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Returning to the video, Mr. Vukovic --

utterances.speaker: MR. RE
utterances.text: Earphones.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: We were up to 13.08, and that was Iza Roka -- 13.08, what street is that?

utterances.speaker: SLOBODAN VUKOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: This is Siroka Ulica looking towards Stradun. And it was in front of the St. Domino's church.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Was that the -- there were two churches, St. Dominik's and St. Domino. Did you inspect St. Domino?

utterances.speaker: SLOBODAN VUKOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Do you see St. Domino church in that photo -- sorry, in that still?

utterances.speaker: SLOBODAN VUKOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: No, you cannot.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: We stopped at 13.13. There's a burnt-out building. 13.04, 13.05. Can you recognise that building?

utterances.speaker: SLOBODAN VUKOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, that is the corner building on the crossroads of Siroka and Od Puca Streets. We called it the Grbic house.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Is that the same building in the photograph now, in the still now at 13.12?

utterances.speaker: SLOBODAN VUKOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, yes. The same.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: 13.15 to 16, which street was that? Can you tell?

utterances.speaker: SLOBODAN VUKOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: That is Od Puca moving from Siroka Street towards Gunduliceva Poljana.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: The video is going into a burnt-out building at 13.26. Which building is that?

utterances.speaker: SLOBODAN VUKOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Could you please give me a broader frame. It's okay. You can stop now.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: I just want you to identify which building it is.

utterances.speaker: SLOBODAN VUKOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: This is a building which was not shown in the first footage. This is a building which I inspected in front of the Orthodox church. It was completely burnt. This is the biggest building in the Od Puca Street amongst those buildings that burned. And we can see that building here.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: That's at 14.39 on the counter. The building which was shown at 13.26 onwards, are you able to say which building that was, which was shown from the inside and outside?

utterances.speaker: SLOBODAN VUKOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: This was one of the palaces. At the beginning of that series of those which I inspected, so going from Siroka Street towards Gunduliceva Poljana. So that's the building which was next to the corner building. It was the interior of the building. I recognised it by the outside openings. It used to be a barbershop.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: The one shown -- is that in Od Puca, the two buildings you've described?

utterances.speaker: SLOBODAN VUKOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, that's the street. It's one in a series of burned-out houses.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: The one we're looking at at the moment, 14.39 on the timer, what's the address of that street? You said you inspected that one. Sorry, what's the address of that building?

utterances.speaker: SLOBODAN VUKOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes. The address is Od Puca number 11. That is block 9, building 17.

utterances.speaker: MR. PETROVIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Your Honour, I would just kindly ask that the record reflect that the witness provided the Trial Chamber with this information from some private notes that he has in front of him.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE PARKER
utterances.text: Mr. Re, could you explore that.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Mr. Vukovic, you just looked into a pile of documents to find that address. What documents were you looking at?

utterances.speaker: SLOBODAN VUKOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: This is a photocopy of the same material. However, it does not have those code numbers of the Court. The text is identical to the text I found here. So it can be seen that it is one and the same building. The answer to the question that was put is that.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: All right. Could I ask you to put your material to one side.

utterances.speaker: SLOBODAN VUKOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: May I intervene.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: We have an identical copy of what you're referring to, which is called P174. We just prefer it if you would get your information from the Court exhibit rather than the identical copy of your own material because the Court copy has the evidence numbers on it. So could I just ask you to put it to one side for a moment and just -- yes.

utterances.speaker: SLOBODAN VUKOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Can I just ask for one thing in relation to what is being discussed now.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE PARKER
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: [Interpretation] In the material that I have as official material that is being used by you all, there is not an accompanying map. So it is hard for me to find my way, to orient myself, so it is only the map that helps me from my material.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE PARKER
utterances.text: It appears, Mr. Re, that what we've called the index is not included in the material the witness has.

utterances.speaker: MR. RE
utterances.text: I think he means the map of the blocks or zones to identify which building is which.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE PARKER
utterances.text: Exhibit 172.

utterances.speaker: MR. RE
utterances.text: That's correct.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE PARKER
utterances.text: Perhaps the witness might have Exhibit 172, and then we'll get back solely to court exhibits.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Mr. Vukovic, if that's your material, can you just please close the binder and just put it aside and use the court material. Number XI-17 is at page 01069572; English is at L0059962. I apologise. I haven't made a note of the number. Can you tell me the number again.

utterances.speaker: SLOBODAN VUKOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: What do you mean? The text or the pictures?

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: The code number. Was it IX-17?

utterances.speaker: SLOBODAN VUKOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, it is IX-17.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: And that's the building described as the Marojice Kaboge, a residential business.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE PARKER
utterances.text: I see in the transcript we have it as XI-17 in one place, and IX-17 as another. Can we be confident in the position?

utterances.speaker: MR. PETROVIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Your Honour, perhaps I can help my learned friend. He is saying IX-17 whereas he is supposed to be looking at XI-17.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: [Interpretation] You're right.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE PARKER
utterances.text: Thank you, Mr. Petrovic. It's good to see cooperation between Defence and Prosecution.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: I'm starting again, I'm sorry, 01069656, XI-17, Od Puca 11, is that the building you're referring to?

utterances.speaker: SLOBODAN VUKOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: That's what we're talking about.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Let's go back to the video. At 14.41, 42, what street is that one?

utterances.speaker: SLOBODAN VUKOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: That is Od Puca Street.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: So 14.59, earlier you referred to the city walls. Is that another shot of the city walls?

utterances.speaker: SLOBODAN VUKOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Whereabouts?

utterances.speaker: SLOBODAN VUKOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Above the western entrance into town, towards Pile. This is the side facing the eastern part.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: What sort of damage can you see to the walls on the right?

utterances.speaker: MR. PETROVIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Your Honour, I'm sorry for interrupting. But this is damage that was already identified in the previous footage. So it would only be fair if my colleague would say that in the so-called Grbic film we saw the same thing, so let's not show one and the same thing twice and depict it as double damage. So it is the very same thing that is simply being shown and identified twice.

utterances.speaker: MR. RE
utterances.text: I'm not arguing with that. I was told I wasn't allowed to lead or put words into the witness's mouth as to where it was.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE PARKER
utterances.text: That's being a little cheap.

utterances.speaker: MR. RE
utterances.text: May it please, Your Honour. I withdraw that comment.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Can you confirm, Mr. Vukovic, that is another shot of the city walls that you saw earlier in P66, the Grbic video?

utterances.speaker: SLOBODAN VUKOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, yes, that was already seen.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Just stop there. You can see a roof in the photo -- in the video at 15.08. And there's a hole in the roof, a red roof, and a roof which has mottled tiles. Where are those two roofs?

utterances.speaker: SLOBODAN VUKOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: As I follow this footage, this is block number 8 in our identification list. I could not tell you which building this is exactly, but that would be its approximate locality.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: We've stopped at 15.04. Whereabouts is that? There's a building with some --

utterances.speaker: SLOBODAN VUKOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: It's the same block. If you mean the building that has a damaged roof, that is a building that is facing the Stradun. And it is within block number 8.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Which street -- you said it's facing the Stradun. Do you mean it's on the corner of the Stradun?

utterances.speaker: SLOBODAN VUKOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: No. It's somewhere around the middle. Actually, it's in the part of block 8 where the festival building is. I think it is vis-a-vis that building.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: What's the side street? When I said on the corner of Stradun, I meant facing Stradun. And there's a gap between those two buildings, meaning there's a street there. What's that street that runs from the Stradun southwards?

utterances.speaker: SLOBODAN VUKOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: I cannot tell you with any certainty. Perhaps it's Getaldiceva. That's just an assumption. I have very few elements that could indicate what this really is.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Okay. We'll stop again at 15.08. Can you be more specific as to which street those two buildings are in?

utterances.speaker: SLOBODAN VUKOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Again, it's block number 8. It's closer to Poljana Paska Milicevica. I cannot tell you exactly which street it is.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: How close is it to the Onofrije fountain?

utterances.speaker: SLOBODAN VUKOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: At least two streets or two rows of buildings away from the Onofrije fountain.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Just taking you back to 15.09, the holes in the roofs of those two buildings, what can you say about the damage to those particular roofs?

utterances.speaker: SLOBODAN VUKOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: It is direct impact. The roof structure was damaged as well as the attic structure. I don't know whether that is sufficient.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Just stop here. At 15.14, you can see a man dressed in overalls wearing a beanie on his head appearing to be doing some building work on a -- while standing on what looks like a balcony. Can you identify which street is just behind -- which street he's facing from that building there?

utterances.speaker: SLOBODAN VUKOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: It's facing Od Puca Street.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: From this wider view at 15.19, does that assist you in identifying the damage -- the location of those buildings with the holes in their roofs we saw a few seconds ago?

utterances.speaker: SLOBODAN VUKOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Could it please be focussed a bit, then I could be able to tell hopefully. This is the building that faced Stradun.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: I can't see what you're referring to. Can you -- there's a building in the corner. That's the Stradun. Is that the one on the corner with the square --

utterances.speaker: SLOBODAN VUKOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: No, no, no, that's not what I'm talking about. I'm talking about the building that was on the previous still.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Do you want to go back?

utterances.speaker: SLOBODAN VUKOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Okay. Just so it's written on the record, we're looking at a shot at 15.20. There's a building to the right -- the one at the bottom of the screen on the right, is that the building on the corner of Stradun and the square in which Onofrije fountain is?

utterances.speaker: SLOBODAN VUKOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, yes, that's the building.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: And what's the street that -- the next street parallel to the square in which the Onofrije fountain is, that runs between those two buildings?

utterances.speaker: SLOBODAN VUKOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Od Garista is the street. And it's a covered street. It's around the middle of this block.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Can you now see from looking at this wider shot where -- in which street were located the buildings with the holes in the roofs.

utterances.speaker: SLOBODAN VUKOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: The only thing I managed to identify here is the first, second, third, fourth street from Poljana Paska Milicevica, the one with the hole in the roof, the one facing Stradun. That's what we had seen in the previous footage before these two roofs that you want me to talk about now. I wasn't sure then, but I am sure now where this building is.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: The streets running from Garista, Zlatariceva, Gunduliceva, and Cubranoviceva, in that order.

utterances.speaker: SLOBODAN VUKOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Would you please repeat that. From the Pasko Milicevic square towards the east, there is Garista.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Followed by Zlatariceva.

utterances.speaker: SLOBODAN VUKOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: The next one after Zlatariceva is Gunduliceva, and the one after that Cubranoviceva. I'm talking about the building at the corner of Cubranoviceva and Stradun. That is block number 8.

utterances.speaker: MR. PETROVIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Your Honour, could I please have this clarified. I don't really understand what the witness's statement is, not only in relation to this particular building, but a series of buildings that we have been dealing with for the past hour and a half or two, or rather that Mr. Re has been dealing with over the past hour and a half or two. So what is the statement of this witness? Which street? Which building? I don't find that to be very clear. Perhaps it's not all that important that things are not clear to me, but I wish it could be made clear.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Could you identify from the map, Mr. Vukovic, that's the plan, you said in block 8, which building it is that we are talking -- that you're talking about here.

utterances.speaker: THE INTERPRETER
utterances.text: The interpreter did not understand the witness's answer.

utterances.speaker: MR. PETROVIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Again, I have to object, Your Honour. Now the witness is looking at the list of damage. Since he's looking at the list of damage, of course it's going to be easy for him to find what it is. And we were trying to have him identify things with the assistance of the videotape, not to have him simply read out from 584. I thought that he was simply supposed to recognise things from the videotape.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE PARKER
utterances.text: Mr. Petrovic, I think you're quite mistaken. The witness has turned simply to Exhibit P172, and he is there looking at the grid systems.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: You've told us it was on the corner of Cubranoviceva and Stradun.

utterances.speaker: SLOBODAN VUKOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes. It's the fourth street from Poljana Paska Milicevica. If that is Cubranoviceva street, then it is Cubranoviceva and Stradun.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: What's the building number?

utterances.speaker: SLOBODAN VUKOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: It is block number 8. The building number is 13.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Thank you.

utterances.speaker: MR. RE
utterances.text: Could I just inform the Trial Chamber for Your Honours' benefit, we have actually plotted on to a computer-generated chart the buildings which we anticipated that Mr. Vukovic would identify from the video. If I were to do this in respect of every building that he looks at and the map, we would be here for a long, long time. Just in the interests of efficiency, I can discuss this with my friend afterwards as to whether he agrees with the ones we put on the map. Because we can certainly identify them from the plan grid.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE PARKER
utterances.text: Thank you.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Moving back to the video, 15.25, is this the city walls?

utterances.speaker: SLOBODAN VUKOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Whereabouts?

utterances.speaker: SLOBODAN VUKOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: This is above the Pile gate. So it's the western side.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: All right. 15.35, the camera has turned out of the Old Town. What's the building it's looking at at the moment?

utterances.speaker: SLOBODAN VUKOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: We see two buildings. In front, we see the Pucic palace, and the Imperial Hotel is in the background. This is the building of the interuniversity centre, right below the greenery.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: 16.01, what is depicted there? What has the camera moved to?

utterances.speaker: SLOBODAN VUKOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Could you please give me a broader context. Okay.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: We're now looking at -- we've shown 16.01 to 16.07. What are we looking at?

utterances.speaker: SLOBODAN VUKOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: 16.07 shows the entrance into the block where the Jadran restaurant is. There were two orange trees in front here, but one of them was felled by the impact.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Just stop there. 16.15, you can see some debris on the ground there. Can you indicate what that is from your experience of inspecting buildings in the Old Town after the 10th of December.

utterances.speaker: SLOBODAN VUKOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: There is a specific thing here. Broken plastic telephone booths, shards of this plastic, and also the tree that was just felled. That's what I can see. And also occasional shrapnel damage.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: 16.25, there's a building with a hole in the roof. Can you identify that building.

utterances.speaker: SLOBODAN VUKOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: I haven't seen it yet.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Just there. 16.23, I'm sorry.

utterances.speaker: SLOBODAN VUKOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: I cannot see it from this camera angle, or rather I cannot recognise it.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: 16.28, there's a red-roofed building with a hole in it. Can you recognise that building, or where it is, the location in the Old Town where the building is?

utterances.speaker: SLOBODAN VUKOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: It is the block that is on the western side of Stradun.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Which block is that --

utterances.speaker: THE INTERPRETER
utterances.text: Interpreter's correction: Northern.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Just tell us which block that is on the plan which you have in front of you.

utterances.speaker: SLOBODAN VUKOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: I cannot tell you with certainty, but this is this zone in any case, near the Franciscan monastery.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: What number is the zone you pointed to?

utterances.speaker: SLOBODAN VUKOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: A37. I think that's there. I cannot really memorise each detail of the roofs. Perhaps I can memorise the streets, but not the roofs.

utterances.speaker: THE INTERPRETER
utterances.text: Could the counsel please wait for the translation to finish before he starts speaking. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE PARKER
utterances.text: The translation was underway, Mr. Petrovic, when you commenced your submission. So we've lost part of you -- or all of you.

utterances.speaker: MR. PETROVIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Your Honours, the witness, on line 18 -- line 19 page 37 [as interpreted] said this was block 2, 3, or 7, but in the transcript, it says A37. And this is an obvious mistake. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE PARKER
utterances.text: Thank you.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: There are 17 numbers marked on that plan. In which block or zone, which number is it out of the 17? That's all we want to know.

utterances.speaker: SLOBODAN VUKOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: I've already said, I'm not sure whether this is one of the three blocks that I'm talking about. So it could be 2, 3, or 7. This would be my closest estimate.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: 16.36 and 16.37, can you recognise where those buildings are?

utterances.speaker: SLOBODAN VUKOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes. These are parts of the Franciscan monastery. This is the east wing which is very close to the festival building. And you can still see traces of smoke there.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: There were two holes in the red roof, which is at 16.37, one near a -- looks like a bell tower sort of structure, and one at the end of it. Is that roof of the Franciscan monastery or complex?

utterances.speaker: SLOBODAN VUKOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: 16.42, you can see a building directly -- building opposite the smoldering or smoking building. Which one is that?

utterances.speaker: SLOBODAN VUKOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: That's the building that I talked about. This is the fourth street from the Paska Milicevica Poljana, and you can also see that from this angle.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Is that the one you described as having a direct impact to the roof?

utterances.speaker: SLOBODAN VUKOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. PETROVIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] I apologise for interrupting my colleague. But for precision, this is a building which is in zone 8, number 13. That is how the witness marked it a little bit earlier, if I'm not mistaken. That's the first thing. Second thing, those two hits on the Franciscan monastery building, we saw that earlier, but we saw that from the courtyard of the monastery, and now we're looking at it from the street. So I just wanted to clarify that.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Let's go to 16.43. We've seen -- we've looked at the city walls before. Is that a similar shot of the city walls Showing a large missing chunk of debris on the walkway.

utterances.speaker: SLOBODAN VUKOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: This is also a part of the western section of the wall near the Franciscan monastery at a place where you can see the front of a former waxworks, where candles were made. And this is a facility that burned down.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: 16.53, what is that a shot of?

utterances.speaker: SLOBODAN VUKOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: This is the dome of the Franciscan monastery bell tower, and it's facing to the east. I think the hit came from the east.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: You're describing a hole towards -- on the left-hand side of the cupola towards the top. Is that correct?

utterances.speaker: SLOBODAN VUKOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, yes.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Did that happen on the 6th of December?

utterances.speaker: SLOBODAN VUKOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: I don't know. I was not a part of that inspection, so I'm not able to confirm that.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: 16.55, there's a shot of some houses showing some roof damage. Do you know where those houses are?

utterances.speaker: SLOBODAN VUKOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: No, I cannot. It's too small, and it's not something that you would see every day.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Is that the same for the still at 17.00 or 17 minutes?

utterances.speaker: SLOBODAN VUKOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: 17.08, there's a close-up shot of an attic missing its walls but retaining its roof. Do you know where that is? We'll keep moving it. It may --

utterances.speaker: SLOBODAN VUKOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: This is in that upper part that I was talking about. These are either blocks 2 or 3 in that sector of town.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Is that the northern part of the Old Town?

utterances.speaker: SLOBODAN VUKOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: North of Stradun.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: 17.10 appears to be another shot of the city walls or walkways. Whereabouts is this one?

utterances.speaker: SLOBODAN VUKOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Would you rewind it a little bit. I have not managed to identify the exact place. This is below Minceta on the part of the walls from Minceta towards the eastern sector. That area is called Peline. That's the street which runs along the walls, and this is a shot of that part of town. And the -- this is damage on the walls. This is just a rough orientation, and I'm not exactly sure what street we're looking at, this street that we can see diagonally down below.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: At 17.23, there were people repairing roofs. Do you know where that is, which part of town it's in?

utterances.speaker: SLOBODAN VUKOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Could you please rewind it a little bit, but I think if it's in the same sequence, then that is also the northern part of town.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: 17.25, 26, 27, you see people repairing roofs. And 17.30. Stop.

utterances.speaker: SLOBODAN VUKOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Stop. Here you can see a series of houses going towards Stradun, and we can see these two square green windows. Behind them is the Od Polaca Street in the top part, so it's in the background. In the forefront of the frame is the continuation of the Nikola Bozidarevica Street, yes, the Nikola Bozidarevica Street. We would need to see exactly what that street is called. The street that goes from Stradun towards Prijeko.

utterances.speaker: MR. RE
utterances.text: Could the witness be shown P13.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: While we're doing that - that's at 17.33 - Mr. Vukovic, I'll just take you back about 8 seconds. The streets or the location of where the people are repairing their roofs at 17.29, do you know where that is?

utterances.speaker: SLOBODAN VUKOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Based on this, you can conclude what it is.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: I'm just showing you a street plan of Dubrovnik. Go back to 17.33. I'm sorry, you said: "Based on this, you can conclude what it is." Which area are we talking about? In 17.33, where are you looking from and to? Which street are you referring to?

utterances.speaker: SLOBODAN VUKOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Well, I don't know if I can say it.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Which part of town --

utterances.speaker: SLOBODAN VUKOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: You're looking from the north part of the walls, from the north part of the town from the walls.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Just indicate on this St. Vid tower area, looking down towards Stradun.

utterances.speaker: SLOBODAN VUKOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, that is in this area here. And you're looking towards here. That is that part here. It's very difficult to say what it is. It could either be Zamanjina Street.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Or?

utterances.speaker: SLOBODAN VUKOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Or Kuniceva. So that would be that area there.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Okay. Thank you. If we just go back a few seconds, the rooftop damage we're looking at and the people repairing at 17.29 and 17.30, is that in the same area you've just been describing, the same approximate area?

utterances.speaker: SLOBODAN VUKOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes. That would be that broad camera angle.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: At 17.38, you can see a building with a hole in the roof. It's a corner building. Where is that building?

utterances.speaker: SLOBODAN VUKOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: It's on the crossroads of the Izmedju Polaca and Nikola Bozidarevica Streets. I think that is still block number 8. It's the bordering area.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Was that a building you inspected yourself?

utterances.speaker: SLOBODAN VUKOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: No. Not that building. I only looked at one building in that block, and that was the Od Polaca.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: What sort of damage can you see on the roof of that building?

utterances.speaker: SLOBODAN VUKOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: I can see that it was a direct hit, and that the roof structure was damaged. The only thing is that I don't know if there were any additional consequences beneath the roof. But what I have said, I have said on the basis of this footage.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Stop there. 17.56 to 17.58, can you recognise the buildings shown in that still?

utterances.speaker: SLOBODAN VUKOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes. If you're thinking of the building with the green windows, that is a block that faces Stradun, and that was a block where I was. And this is a building that I visited.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Which cross street -- sorry, what's the nearest cross street?

utterances.speaker: SLOBODAN VUKOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: We can see the street in the background. It's a building facing the Od Polaca Street. Could you please just rewind it a little bit. A little bit more, please. Stop. I think that this is Miha Pracata Street, which goes from Stradun to the southern section of town.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: The transcript reads "Od Polaca." Do you mean Od Puca?

utterances.speaker: SLOBODAN VUKOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Od Polaca.

utterances.speaker: MR. RE
utterances.text: I note the time, Your Honours. Your Honours probably want to know how much longer I will be.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE PARKER
utterances.text: You're spot on, Mr. Re.

utterances.speaker: MR. RE
utterances.text: There's about 3 minutes left of this video. At the current rate, that should take about 10 minutes, I'd think, to complete. I also wish to have the witness mark with some circles on the overhead map which I tendered yesterday of locations. I drew a legend in white on the side, and there's one other exhibit that I wish to take him to. So I would hope an hour or so.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE PARKER
utterances.text: It seems to be three times the estimated length of examination of this witness.

utterances.speaker: MR. RE
utterances.text: In the original assessment, it probably would have been. The difficulty the Prosecution has had has been with the Exhibit P51/ID and having to go through --

utterances.speaker: JUDGE PARKER
utterances.text: Just looking at the last letter to the Chamber, which indicated three hours for this witness. You've now had eight.

utterances.speaker: MR. RE
utterances.text: I'll try and finish in half an hour tomorrow if I could.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE PARKER
utterances.text: We have been patient, Mr. Re. But a lot of this detail seems closer than appears to us presently to be necessary.

utterances.speaker: MR. RE
utterances.text: All I can say is in the absence of any agreement as to the extent of damage and where it occurred in the Old Town, unfortunately we felt compelled to take the witness through fairly specific detail.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE PARKER
utterances.text: We will adjourn now and resume tomorrow. Could we indicate that there is the question of the submissions about the fitness of the accused. I think it would be appropriate if they were heard first thing tomorrow morning, and then we'll continue with this witness. We don't want that question to just keep being put off. So we will resume tomorrow morning.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE PARKER
utterances.text: to be reconvened on Thursday, the 6th day of May, 2004, at 9.00 a.m. 19 20 21 22 23 24 25

procedural_notes.text: --- Whereupon the hearing adjourned at 1.48 p.m.,
